title: Meet Tania: The WebSwan family
cta: Your success is our story to tell

scenes.text: Hi, I'm Tania, founder of The WebSwan.
scenes.action: Smiling at the camera in a bright modern office, a small wave

scenes.text: I help doctors and attorneys look great online, stay protected, and get found.
scenes.action: Walking toward the camera with relaxed hand gestures

scenes.text: The WebSwan builds your website and your own phone app.
scenes.action: Sitting at a desk, pointing to a laptop screen

scenes.text: WebSwan Digital Solutions checks your website for ADA and privacy risks.
scenes.action: Leaning slightly forward, serious but warm expression

scenes.text: And WebSwan Media Network helps the right patients and clients find you.
scenes.action: Smiling, open hand gesture toward the camera

scenes.text: Your success is our story to tell. Let's talk.
scenes.action: Confident smile, nodding at the camera
